description:
https://github.com/I3Well/ExchangeRefit/releases/tag/v1.4.1

Dependencies: None (100% Standalone!)
Supported Mod Utilities: Version Checker, Advanced Gunnery Control (AGC), AI Tweaks, Progressive S-Mods

The Power of Universal & Shareable Blueprints!

ExchangeRefit doesn't just clone ships within a save file. It introduces a powerful plain-text blueprint system stored directly inside your common Starsector save folder.
• Cross-Save Compatibility: A ship loadout saved in your current campaign can be instantly reloaded and applied in a completely brand-new playthrough!
• Community Sharing: You can easily copy your blueprint text files and send them to other players (or download theirs) to mirror exact setups in a single click!
• Zero Friction: Never manually re-fit a fleet of identical hulls weapon-by-weapon again, and never struggle to remember your favorite builds from previous games.

What is ExchangeRefit?
ExchangeRefit adds an accessible Shipyard Terminal in the campaign space map (via the [K] hotkey) to scan, duplicate, archive, and paste complete ship loadouts using fleet cargo, alongside managing s-mods.

Core Features Overview
• Deep Analysis & Tracking: A detailed diagnostic panel displays stats (DP, shields, speed, OP) while automatically tracking exact OP costs, origins, and factions for all mounted weapons, hullmods, S-Mods, and fighter wings.

• Dynamic Cargo Comparison & Alerts: The terminal compares your saved blueprints directly against your current fleet cargo, issuing clear alerts to highlight missing weapons, wings, or hullmods before application.

• Selective Copy & Paste (Modular Filters): You have total control over what you apply. Using 8 toggle modules, you can choose to copy the entire ship or select only specific parts (e.g., paste only the weaponry, only the S-Mods, or only the hullmods) from your saved blueprint.

Interface & Technical Notes
• Bilingual Support: Features English by default with an easy French translation toggle available in the config file.
• Compatibility & Stability: Triggered via the [K] hotkey in open space, featuring support for AGC, AI Tweaks, and Version Checker, alongside recent stability and memory cache fixes in v1.4.1.

How to change language / Comment changer la langue
1. Go to mods/ExchangeRefit/data/config/
2. Open exchangerefit_config.json
3. Change "french_translation" to true or false.

How to Share Loadouts Between Players
To Export/Send a build:
1. Save your ship layout in-game on any Slot (like Slot 1).
2. Go to your main Starsector directory, then open the folder: saves / common
3. Locate the file named: ExchangeRefit_HullId_Slot1.txt
4. Send this file to your friend (via Discord, Email, etc.).

To Import/Receive a build:
1. Download your friend text file and place it inside your own saves / common directory.
2. (Optional) You can rename Slot1 in the filename to Slot3 if you want to place it in your 3rd slot!
3. Open the game, access the ExchangeRefit terminal at any station, select the matching ship hull, and click Paste!

Installation
1. Download the zip file from the official Release repository.
2. Extract the ExchangeRefit folder into your Starsector / mods / directory.
3. Enable ExchangeRefit in the Starsector launcher.
4. Enjoy your smooth refitting sessions!

DOWNLOAD LINK :
https://github.com/I3Well/ExchangeRefit/releases#release-v1.4.1

Author Note
As this is my very first mod, I am fully committed to improving and maintaining ExchangeRefit! I will be deeply attentive to all feedback, bug reports, feature suggestions, and critiques, as long as they remain constructive. Let us make this tool better together!

Behind the Code / Developer's Note
As I learn the Starsector API, I used AI tools to assist with the architecture and logic of this mod. This project is a complete evolution of my original concept (previously released under the name Anjasnare).
